svg.title: B747 longitudinal autopilot system architecture
svg.desc: Block diagram showing the full pipeline: reference commands, mode logic, PID controller, B747 plant with gust disturbance, noisy sensor measurements, adaptive Kalman filter with augmented gust states, and GRU correction layer.
